subject: OneTrust evidence cleanup workshop for Alpha Health
messages:
From: Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@alphahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: security-admin@alphahealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: evidence merge & walkthrough for OneTrust profile (Alpha Health)

Hi Vivek,

We just finished onboarding our vendor security profile for Alpha Health into OneTrust and ran into a mess of duplicate evidence entries and inconsistent filenames across the profile. The intake team asked us to clean this up before the upcoming SOC 2 readiness review.

Could Redwood run a short walkthrough with our security team to:
- Review the current OneTrust profile and identify duplicates/stale artifacts
- Confirm which artifacts map to CAIQ/SIG controls vs. SOC 2 criteria
- Agree on a plan to remove/replace the stale files and publish a clean evidence set

I attached an evidence index export (AlphaHealth-SOC2-evidence-index.xlsx) that shows the duplicates. We expect 30-45 minutes should be enough. Our preferred windows this week are Thu 10:00–12:00 PT or Fri 13:00–16:00 PT.

Thanks — really appreciate the help.

Sandra Lopez
Sr. InfoSec Program Manager
Alpha Health
attachments: AlphaHealth-SOC2-evidence-index.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@alphahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: evidence merge & walkthrough for OneTrust profile (Alpha Health)

Thanks Sandra — happy to help. Can confirm a 30–45 minute workshop will cover the cleanup scope you described. Thu 10:30 PT works for me; if that fits your team let’s lock it.

Before the call, could you share the following so we come prepared:
1) OneTrust org ID and the profile IDs you are targeting (or a link to the profile)
2) A quick list of the artifact types you want us to prioritize (e.g., network diagrams, configuration screenshots, IAM policies)
3) Any retention/PII redaction rules we should follow when suggesting deletions

We’ll bring a simple cleanup plan: map CAIQ/SIG controls to the evidence you already have, mark duplicates/stale items, and propose either a merge or archive approach per artifact type. Marissa will own the evidence mapping during the call and Neha will help with access questions and OneTrust uploads.

If you prefer, we can also create a short shared Drive folder for the artifacts so we don’t upload working copies directly into OneTrust until we agree.

Cheers,

Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@alphahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: evidence merge & walkthrough for OneTrust profile (Alpha Health)

Hi Sandra — thanks for the index. I uploaded a sanitized snapshot and a short pre-read to a shared Drive (link below) and included the OneTrust org/profile IDs you asked for.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C4d5E6F
OneTrust Org: AH-ORG-9987
Profile IDs: AH-PRO-2026-01 (primary), AH-PRO-2025-09 (legacy)

What we’ll bring to the workshop:
- A control->evidence mapping (CAIQ and SOC 2 crosswalk)
- A proposed cleanup playbook: archive vs merge vs replace (per artifact type)
- A short checklist for evidence hygiene (file naming, metadata, retention tags)

Notes/questions for you:
- Do you want us to redact or replace PII in screenshots before we suggest archiving?
- Any procurement or governance steps required before we remove artifacts from the profile?

I attached the network diagram we found in the index (network-diagram.pdf) — it looks current but has three copies with slightly different names.

Marissa Cole
Technical Programs — Security Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: network-diagram.pdf
From: Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@alphahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, security-admin@alphahealth.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: evidence merge & walkthrough for OneTrust profile (Alpha Health)

Thanks — Thu 10:30 PT works and I’ve invited the rest of the Alpha Health security intake group. Per your request we will:
- Upload the three latest config screenshots and the canonical network diagram to the shared Drive by EOD today
- Add short notes to the Drive items indicating which SOC 2 control they support
- Opened OneTrust ticket OT-4821 to track the profile merge (https://onetrust.example.com/tickets/OT-4821)

Answering Marissa: please do not assume PII redaction is allowed — we’ll flag items with PII and provide redacted copies where needed. Procurement sign-off is not required to archive duplicates but compliance should be looped in for any deletions.

See you Thursday — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Sandra Lopez
Sr. InfoSec Program Manager
Alpha Health
attachments: AlphaHealth-SOC2-evidence-index.xlsx
